statement.zh: **标准**：安全散列标准（Secure Hash Standard）。题页的宣告行写「Announcing the SECURE HASH STANDARD」，文告第 1 条把名称与编号钉在一起：「1.Name of Standard: Secure Hash Standard (SHS) (FIPS PUB 180-4).」摘要给出自我定义：「This standard specifies hash algorithms that can be used to generate digests of messages.」下一句交代用途：「The digests are used to detect whether messages have been changed since the digests were generated.」第 3 条逐个点名算法并给出对象：「3.Explanation: This Standard specifies secure hash algorithms - SHA-1, SHA-224, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, SHA-512/224 and SHA-512/256 - for computing a condensed representation of electronic data (message).」同一节限定输出：「The message digests range in length from 160 to 512 bits, depending on the algorithm.
statement.en: **Standard**: Secure Hash Standard (安全散列标准).The masthead announces "Announcing the SECURE HASH STANDARD" and clause 1 fixes name and number together: "1.

statement.zh: 理由写在第 3 条的第二段，用两条困难性定义 secure：「The hash algorithms specified in this Standard are called secure because, for a given algorithm, it is computationally infeasible 1) to find a message that corresponds to a given message digest, or 2) to find two different messages that produce the same message digest.」后果紧接一句：「This will result in a verification failure when the secure hash algorithm is used with a digital signature algorithm or a keyed-hash message authentication algorithm.」第 1 节给出结构前提：「All of the algorithms are iterative, one-way hash functions that can process a message to produce a condensed representation called a message digest.
statement.en: The reason is stated in clause 3, where the two infeasibilities define the term: "The hash algorithms specified in this Standard are called secure because, for a given algorithm, it is computationally infeasible 1) to find a message that corresponds to a given message digest, or 2) to find two different messages that produce the same message digest." The consequence follows at once: "This will result in a verification failure when the secure hash algorithm is used with a digital signature algorithm or a keyed-hash message authentication algorithm.

statement.zh: 应用义务写在文告的适用与实现两条。第 6 条用 must 落到联邦用法：「Either this Standard or Federal Information Processing Standard (FIPS) 202 must be implemented wherever a secure hash algorithm is required for Federal applications, including as a component within other cryptographic algorithms and protocols.」第 8 条先开放实现载体：「8.Implementations: The secure hash algorithms specified herein may be implemented in software, firmware, hardware or any combination thereof.」再给出合规关口：「Only algorithm implementations that are validated by NIST will be considered as complying with this standard.」两句层级不同：前者是联邦应用中 must 级的实现要求，后者把合规认定系于 NIST 验证，算法本身正确并不足以构成符合。
statement.en: The application duties are in the applicability and implementation clauses.Clause 6 uses must for federal use: "Either this Standard or Federal Information Processing Standard (FIPS) 202 must be implemented wherever a secure hash algorithm is required for Federal applications, including as a component within other cryptographic algorithms and protocols." Clause 8 first leaves the carrier open: "8.

statement.zh: 三处限度均出自文件自身。第 12 条先否认符合即安全：「While it is the intent of this Standard to specify general security requirements for generating a message digest, conformance to this Standard does not assure that a particular implementation is secure.」并把判断交给使用方：「The responsible authority in each agency or department shall assure that an overall implementation provides an acceptable level of security.」强度问题则明确另交他文：「The algorithms differ most significantly in the security strengths that are provided for the data being hashed.
statement.en: Three limits are the document speaking about itself.Clause 12 denies that conformance is security: "While it is the intent of this Standard to specify general security requirements for generating a message digest, conformance to this Standard does not assure that a particular implementation is secure." and assigns the judgement: "The responsible authority in each agency or department shall assure that an overall implementation provides an acceptable level of security." Strength is handed to other documents: "The algorithms differ most significantly in the security strengths that are provided for the data being hashed.

statement.zh: 题页两行连读为「Federal Information Processing Standards Publication 180-4 August 2015」，即这份副本的日期行是 2015 年 8 月；其下的免费获取行写「This publication is available free of charge from:」，其后是 DOI 10.6028/NIST.FIPS.180-4。前言署名为「Charles H.Romine, Director Information Technology Laboratory」；文告第 4 条把批准权写成「4.Approving Authority: Secretary of Commerce.」取代关系见第 3 条末句：「This Standard supersedes FIPS 180-3 [FIPS 180-3].」本文件没有作者栏，署名是商务部长、NIST 所长（兼标准与技术副部长）与信息技术实验室主任；这份留存文本只给出 2015 年 8 月的日期行与被取代的 180-3，未见 180-4 自身初版日期的记载。
statement.en: The two masthead lines read in sequence "Federal Information Processing Standards Publication 180-4 August 2015", so this copy carries the date line August 2015; below it the free-access line reads "This publication is available free of charge from:" followed by the DOI 10.6028/NIST.FIPS.180-4.The foreword is signed "Charles H.
